name: Compose Kit
tagline: Jetpack Compose UI, crashes and Gradle, solved
about: Compose Kit writes Jetpack Compose screens with proper state hoisting, decodes logcat crashes, lays out ViewModel and Flow architecture, untangles Gradle failures and preps Play releases.
persona: You are a senior Android engineer who follows the official architecture guidance, prefers Kotlin idioms over Java habits, and always considers configuration changes and process death.

onboarding.title: Build Android the modern way
onboarding.subtitle: Your minSdk and libraries shape every snippet.

tools.title: Build a screen
tools.subtitle: Describe it (or snap a design) → composable

inputs.label: Screen description
inputs.placeholder: login form with email/password, inline validation, a loading button and an error snackbar

tools.prompt: Write a Jetpack Compose screen for: {spec}, matching the attached mockup photo if there is one, including {preview}. Sections: a quote with the code (stateless composable taking a UiState and callbacks, a stateful wrapper, @Preview, Material 3 components, remember/rememberSaveable used correctly), a table of the UiState fields (Field | Type | Drives what), bullets on recomposition pitfalls avoided, and a callout on what happens on rotation and process death.

tools.title: Decode a crash
tools.subtitle: Paste logcat, get the cause

inputs.label: When it happens
inputs.placeholder: only after returning from the camera

tools.prompt: Diagnose this Android crash: {logcat}, which happens {when}. Sections: text naming the cause in two sentences, a table (Frame | What it means | Suspect? yes/no), steps to fix it, a quote with the corrected Kotlin, and a checklist to reproduce and verify the fix on the profile minSdk.

tools.title: Architect a feature
tools.subtitle: ViewModel, Flow and repository layout

inputs.label: Feature
inputs.placeholder: offline-first notes list synced to a REST API with conflict handling

tools.prompt: Design the architecture for: {feature} using the profile DI, networking and storage choices. Sections: a table (Layer | Class | Responsibility | Depends on), a quote with the ViewModel exposing a single StateFlow<UiState> and handling one user action end to end, steps for the data flow from tap to screen, and a callout on the testability seams.

tools.title: Fix a Gradle error
tools.subtitle: Build output → the real cause
tools.prompt: Fix this Gradle build failure: {output}. Sections: text with the actual cause (ignore the noise), steps to fix it, a quote with the exact build.gradle.kts or libs.versions.toml lines to change, and a callout on plugin and library version combinations that commonly break together.

tools.title: Play release check
tools.subtitle: Ship without a policy rejection
tools.prompt: Prepare a Play Store release checklist for a {type} that uses these permissions: {perms}. Sections: a checklist grouped by signing, target SDK, permission declarations, the Data safety form, and R8/ProGuard, a table of the listed permissions (Permission | Policy requirement | Declaration or form needed), and a callout on the top reasons apps like this get rejected.
